answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital ridge in decentralized networks, preventing Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral to participate in consensus. This mechanism ensures that the cost of scaling fake identities scales linearly with the asset value, creating a horizon where the pearl of network integrity is preserved because an attacker would need to acquire a majority of total stake to manipulate the ledger, rendering identity spoofing economically irrational.
